name: Knight of New Alara
oracle_text: Each other multicolored creature you control gets +1/+1 for each of its colors.
blocked_sentences: Each other multicolored creature you control gets +1/+1 for each of its colors.

needs.what: a static value that reads a characteristic of EACH affected object rather than one board-wide number: the number of colors of the creature the buff is being applied to ("+1/+1 for each of its colors"), so a buff static's power/toughness can be {"colors_of_affected": true}-style and differ per creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_value_keys (count, counters_on, mana_symbols, distinct, ...) all evaluate to one number for the whole static; counters_on with self_only reads the source, not the affected creature, and none counts an object's colors

needs.what: `min_colors: 2` (two or more colors, 202.2b) in a static's `affects` filter, so "multicolored creature you control" can be said
needs.why_existing_wont_do: min_colors exists in the spell/trigger filter vocabulary but is not in static_affects_filter_keys; `colors` is a membership test (a mono-green creature matches ["G","W"])
